aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'National Institute of Technology Sikkim fails to provide many facilities as [an] NIT student should have, for its temporary campus. The temporary campus is really congested in [a] 20 acre area. All the higher authorities are saying that the permanent campus will be made after 3 years minimum from this year, at that time I will be [a] graduated alumna.'
'You can take admission in this college if you want an NIT tag with [a] low rank, otherwise you can prepare one year more, take [a] drop and avoid these northeast colleges.'

'Some good things about our campus [are that the] college experience is good because of the surrounding hills and mountains. You will love the sunrises in winter season here; the temperature is kind of cold, normally, but in winters the temperature goes below 0 at night.'
'The facility was not much in the hostel as well as the classroom, but still whatever is affordable is giving [value].'
'The girls to boys ratio is very less so take care for that.'
'The rules and regulation, and yes the mess regulation, [are] [dis]gusting.'

'Placement is all about your preparation as opportunities come too much but if you have power then crack that one. Highest [package] going in 2024 batch is 44 LPA and 66 percent was placed as there [was] a recession going on this time due to Covid, [when] all markets crashed.'
'There is [a] very good environment in Sikkim, Mount Kanchenjunga is clearly visible from hostel rooms. [A] very peaceful place for study. Most of [the] professors are well qualified here.'
'Faculties used to teach industry-relevant things. So, despite being so much problem here, students used to [get] placed in big MNCs from here like Apple, Nvidia, Microsoft.'
'Right now, infrastructure here is not well; in hostels there is fixed timing for water supply. But there is [a] new permanent campus [being] set up in [Kham]dong, so we are hoping for better.'

'Some professors are literally so irritable here. They treat students like school-going nursery kids. Academic pressure is so much here, professors used to give so much assignments, projects, copy-paste stuff, etc.; they used to take viva, class tests, presentation regularly (every week).'

review_items.review_title: What is the condition of the hostel of NIT Sikkim?
review_items.extraction_note: This corroborates the theme of temporary, off-campus, rented first-year hostel buildings found across multiple sources for this institution, with a specific added detail about lack of Wi-Fi in these particular buildings.

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'For first year boys, [the] hostel is outside the campus, nearly 2 km from the campus. There are 3 hostel buildings namely BH-11, BH-12 and BH-13. These buildings consist of rooms shared by 2, 3 and maximum 4 people according to their size. There is no Wi-Fi for these hostels.'

review_items.review_title: what is placement scenario in NIT SIKKIM FOR MTECH (electrical)
review_items.extraction_note: Explicitly M.Tech-scoped, distinct from B.Tech evidence per programme-scope requirement.

aspect_evidence.evidence_summary: 'NIT Sikkim placements are increasing year by year and its almost fine as compared to its location and infrastructure. In electrical dept., students got placements over 10 LPA in both B.Tech and M.Tech. Also the average salary was around 6-7 LPA. Many govt. undertakings like Powergrid, Bharat Petroleum etc. also offered jobs (55-60% placed). Companies like Intel, IBM, Bosch also offered jobs (in ongoing 2020 season).'
